messages.author: af7326e6e4587ea1
messages.subject: spectro & dfreq overplot - roughness
parts:
I am new to this package but familiar with R.
Congratulations to this nice piece of software!
I was successful with some routines but I encountered also
problems I could not fix.

>In spite of specifying xaxs="i",yaxs="i" dfreq overplotted my restriction
(flim=c(0,3.5)) of the spectro plot. How can I force dfreq to follow this?
spectro(LKW2,f=22050, flim=c(0,3.5),flab="Frequenz in kHz",scale=FALSE)
par(new=TRUE)
dfreq(LKW2, f=22050,threshold=5,xaxs="i",yaxs="i",pch=24,bg="white",ann=FALSE)
Using flim=c(0,3.5) with dfreq did not work either

>I do not understand the error message
spec <- meanspec(LKW0, plot=FALSE)
roughness(LKW0)
#Error in r[i1] : object of type 'S4' is not subsettable

Thank you for your help
Peter

messages.author: e14cfb57d640984d
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] spectro & dfreq overplot - roughness
parts:
Hi Peter,

You're passing in your Wave object, LKW0, rather than a vector as it expects.

You could alter your code snippet at the bottom to read

spec <- meanspec(LKW0, plot=FALSE)
roughness(spec)

best,
jesse
